arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT b.*, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id) AS charges, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('kind',e.kind,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id) AS customer_events FROM bookings b WHERE b.status <> 'confirmed'

SELECT 'pending_bookings' AS check_name, count(*) AS violations FROM bookings WHERE status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'confirmed_backing',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured')<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id AND i.flight_id=b.flight_id AND i.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered'))
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_backing',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id AND e.kind='cancel'))
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_request_confirmed',count(*) FROM bookings b JOIN customer_events e ON b.request_id=e.request_id WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND e.kind='cancel'
UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid_hold',count(*) FROM holds h LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=h.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR h.flight_id<>b.flight_id OR h.passenger_id<>b.passenger_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold_flights',count(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity
UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid_checkin',count(*) FROM checkins i LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=i.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.status<>'confirmed' OR i.flight_id<>b.flight_id OR i.passenger_id<>b.passenger_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_charge',count(*) FROM charges c LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sale',count(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'undelivered_events',count(*) FROM outbox WHERE status<>'delivered'
UNION ALL SELECT 'unwarranted_refund',count(*) FROM refunds r LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=r.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.status<>'cancelled'
